Prepare Household-Level ENAHO Microdata and Calibrate Official FIES Scores

Source: R/prepare_fies.R
prepare_fies.Rd

Reads ENAHO Module 2082 (`enaho01-<year>-130`, Food Insecurity Experience Scale) and Module 34 (`sumaria-<year>-12g`), merges optional household and member modules (`"housing"`, `"demographics"`, `"education_health"`, `"programs"`), fits the official INEI annual weighted Rasch model, equates severities to the FAO global reference scale, and returns a clean household-level [tibble::tibble()] ready for both [estimate_fies()] and regression modeling (e.g., [survey::svyglm()]).

Usage

prepare_fies(
  years = 2025,
  include = "core",
  cache_dir = fies_cache_dir(),
  local_dir = NULL,
  sample_data = NULL,
  download = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

years

Integer vector of annual survey years (`>= 2025`). Defaults to `2025`.

include

Character vector specifying which module blocks to download: `"core"` (default: Module 2082 FIES + Module 34 Sumaria), `"housing"` (Module 01), `"demographics"` (Module 02), `"education_health"` (Modules 03 and 04), `"programs"` (Module 37), or `"all"`.

cache_dir

Character path to the local cache directory. Defaults to [fies_cache_dir()].

local_dir

Optional path to a local folder containing manually downloaded `.dta` or `.sav` ENAHO files (either flat, such as `"D:/Inseguridad_Alimentaria_2025"`, or organized in `ModuloXX` subfolders). When `NULL` (default), reads from `cache_dir`.

sample_data

Optional pre-loaded list or data frame (such as [fies_sample]) for fast offline demonstration and testing without reading external files.

download

Logical; if `TRUE` (default) and `local_dir` is `NULL`, automatically calls [download_fies()] for any requested module missing from `cache_dir`.

quiet

Logical; if `TRUE`, suppresses progress messages. Defaults to `FALSE`.

Value

A [tibble::tibble()] of class `"fies_tbl"` with one row per surveyed household, containing survey design keys (`conglome`, `estrato`, `wt_hh`, `wt_pop`), official INEI geographies (`area`, `department`, `region_inei`, `natural_region`), monetary poverty indicators, binary FIES items (`fies_worried`..`fies_whlday`), raw score (`fies_rs`), household probabilities of moderate-or-severe (`pr_mod_sev`) and severe (`pr_sev`) food insecurity, and any requested sociodemographic blocks. Annual Rasch model diagnostics are stored in `attr(x, "rasch_models")`.

Examples

# Offline demonstration using the bundled synthetic sample
df_demo <- prepare_fies(sample_data = fies_sample, quiet = TRUE)
head(df_demo[, c("year", "area", "poverty", "fies_rs", "pr_mod_sev", "pr_sev")])
#> # A tibble: 6 × 6
#>    year area  poverty  fies_rs pr_mod_sev     pr_sev
#>   <int> <fct> <fct>      <int>      <dbl>      <dbl>
#> 1  2025 Rural Non-Poor       1     0.0335 0.00000723
#> 2  2025 Urban Poor           3     0.349  0.0000872 
#> 3  2025 Urban Non-Poor       1     0.0335 0.00000723
#> 4  2025 Rural Poor           7     0.993  0.539     
#> 5  2025 Urban Non-Poor       0     0.0271 0.0000704 
#> 6  2025 Urban Non-Poor       2     0.115  0.00000784
